testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind colors like blue-500 or gray-100; use custom hex codes defined here.

Use Playfair Display for all headings and Manrope for body text. Add `<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700;900&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>` to index.html.
For the storefront, build custom HTML/Tailwind structures with generous spacing and bento grids. Avoid wrapping everything in generic Shadcn cards.
For the admin dashboard, you may use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their border radius and colors to match the earthy palette.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major sections.
Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile. Ensure all images use the exact URLs provided in this file, DO NOT use placeholder services.
